title: Eiffel Tower
answer: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1899. The Eiffel Tower is about 330 metres tall. The Eiffel Tower is the tallest structure in Paris.
hallucinations: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1899.
facts: Built from 1887 to 1889; 330 metres tall; tallest structure in Paris.

title: Albert Einstein
answer: Albert Einstein was born in Vienna in 1885. Albert Einstein was a theoretical physicist.
hallucinations: Albert Einstein was born in Vienna in 1885.

title: Taj Mahal
answer: The Taj Mahal is a marble mausoleum in Agra, India. The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the emperor Akbar.
hallucinations: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the emperor Akbar.
facts: Commissioned in 1631 by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal, on the Yamuna in Agra.

title: Mount Everest
answer: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay first climbed Mount Everest in 1963. Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth.
hallucinations: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay first climbed Mount Everest in 1963.
facts: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary made the first documented ascent in 1953.

title: Jupiter
answer: Jupiter is the third planet from the Sun. Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. Ganymede is larger than the planet Mercury.
hallucinations: Jupiter is the third planet from the Sun.
facts: Fifth planet from the Sun and the largest; Ganymede is larger than Mercury.

title: Mars
answer: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. Mars has three natural satellites.
facts: Fourth planet; two moons, Phobos and Deimos.

title: Marie Curie
answer: Marie Curie was the first person to win a Nobel Prize twice. Marie Curie became the first woman professor at the University of Oxford in 1906.
hallucinations: Marie Curie became the first woman professor at the University of Oxford in 1906.
facts: First person to win two Nobel Prizes; in 1906 the first woman professor at the University of Paris.

title: Telephone
answer: Alexander Graham Bell received the first patent for the electric telephone in 1880. The telephone is a telecommunications device.
hallucinations: Alexander Graham Bell received the first patent for the electric telephone in 1880.
facts: Bell received the first US patent for the electric telephone in March 1876.

title: France (all correct)
answer: France is a country primarily located in Western Europe. Paris is the capital of France.
facts: Country primarily located in Western Europe; capital and largest city is Paris.

title: Japan and India (all correct)
answer: Tokyo is the capital of Japan. India is the most populous country in the world.
facts: Tokyo is Japan's capital (japan.txt); India is the most populous country (india.txt).
